description.value:
You know of ways to leverage the blood or soul of creatures to study them or watch them – you just need a little bit of it. If you manage to procure a small amount of blood or fragments of spiritual essence from a creature, you can store it in a cruorum or spirilux. Once per day, you can ponder the cruorum or spirilux holding this essence to cast Scrying on that particular creature as an innate occult spell once per day, using your spell DC or class DC for the saving throw, whichever is higher. If you also bear their name, a possession or a piece of its body as normal for Scrying, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the DC.

If you can cast spells, you can leverage your stored blood or spiritual essence inside this stored container to empower a spell that targets that creature, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to your spell attack or spell DC. Afterwards however, the container breaks and the blood or essence is lost, and you cannot use Forbidden Rite for any benefit to that creature for 1 week.
